notes: Shopify site, reached directly (plain HTTP GET, HTTP 200, no proxy needed). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Checked main nav (Furniture / Decor mega-menus, top-level items are Furniture, Decor, What's New, brand pages, Mattresses, Gift Cards - no 'Sale'/'Clearance'/'Outlet' item), footer (Help/Shop/Company columns - no clearance/outlet link), and sitemap_collections_1.xml scanned case-insensitively for clearance/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of-line/discontinued - zero matches for any of those terms anywhere in the collection list. Direct URL probes for /collections/clearance, /clearance-sale, /outlet, /clearance-outlet, /final-sale, /last-chance, /end-of-line, /discontinued all returned 404 - none of these collections exist. Site search (site's own /search?type=collection) for 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final sale', and 'last chance' returned no dedicated clearance/outlet result - only surfaced the same set of generic seasonal/event Sale pages (tent-sale, black-friday-sale, labor-day-sale), confirming the search is non-discriminating for this term rather than proving true absence, so I relied on the direct nav/sitemap/URL checks above as the actual absence proof. The site DOES expose several temporary promotional Sale collections found via sitemap: Tent Sale (388 items, /collections/tent-sale-05-2026), Flash Sale (37, /collections/flash-sale), Pillow and Rug Sale (926, /collections/pillow-and-rug-sale), Furniture Sale (16, /collections/furniture-sale-1), Independence Day Sale (8148, /collections/independence-day-sale), Black Friday Sale (116, /collections/black-friday-sale-1), Fall Kickoff Sale (141, /collections/fall-kickoff-sale), and Labor Day Sale (313, /collections/laborday2026, currently promoted via an on-site popup banner through 2026-09-10). I opened each and read its title/H1 - every one is named and framed strictly as a dated/event-based promotional Sale (Tent Sale, Flash Sale, a specific holiday name), with no Clearance/Outlet/Final Clearance/Last Chance/End of Line language anywhere on the page, breadcrumb, or nav label, and no on-page copy describing permanent markdown or outlet stock. Per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance test these are generic temporary promotional campaigns, not Clearance, so none are recorded as rows (not even as ambiguous flags, since none of them carry any clearance-adjacent signal to flag - they are unambiguously seasonal/event Sale pages). Conclusion: this site genuinely does not have a Clearance-type merchandising PLP.
